title: SCS-001 — Load trending topics from viral-topics.json in batch-produce (no more generic content)
rationale: PM2 scs001-pipeline runs batch-produce.ts with no --topic args, so educational and entertainment pipelines use hardcoded generic topics ('AI is changing everything you know'). viral-topics.json is refreshed by topic-radar before each run. Fix: in batch-produce main(), when topics array is empty, load from viral-topics.json and shuffle/select N topics for the run.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/batch-produce.ts, after parseArgs(), if topics.length === 0, load from workspace/scs001/viral-topics.json (try 'viral_topics' array field first, then 'topics'). Shuffle and take up to 'runs' topics. Log the source. Fall through silently if file missing or parse fails.
